exposure: Indications for radical thoracic reirradiation for non-small cell lung cancer
Practice of radical thoracic reirradiation for non-small cell lung cancer
Planning of radiation therapy for reirradiation
outcome: Expert consensus guidance on safe practice of thoracic reirradiation
Consensus statements on reirradiation definition, patient selection, assessments, planning, and dose constraints
cohort: The participants were 15 international thoracic radiation oncologists who contributed to a Delphi consensus process.
finding: The study established expert consensus guidance on appropriate patient selection for thoracic reirradiation in non-small cell lung cancer, optimal radiation therapy techniques (including image guidance and conformal methods), and cumulative dose constraints for organs at risk.
